item.title: RSS story
item.content:encoded:
The feed carries the whole article, which is what makes a stored copy worth having: the reader can show it without asking the site for anything at all.

This second paragraph exists so the text comfortably clears the length a teaser never reaches, and so a test can tell an article from a one-line description.

A third paragraph with a relative link that the reader resolves against the story.
